name: Musafid Toolkit for WooCommerce
author: getwpkit

sections.description:
Musafid is the ultimate lightweight, modular toolkit designed to skyrocket your WooCommerce store’s conversions, streamline checkout, customize emails, and track sales performance—all in one place.

Unlike heavy, multi-feature plugins that slow down your website, Musafid is built with a modular architecture (like Jetpack). You only enable the features you need. Disabled modules consume zero resources and load no scripts, maintaining blazing-fast page load speeds to improve your Google Core Web Vitals and SEO rankings.

Whether you want to boost average order value, recover lost sales, speed up checkout, or prevent fraud — Musafid gives you focused, conflict-free tools that work together, without bloating your site.

🚀 Key Modules Included:

  1. Package Builder (Custom Product Bundles)

    • Let customers build their own product bundle and earn tiered discounts — by item count or cart total, as a percentage or a fixed amount.
    • Set minimum and maximum item rules, with server-side validation that can’t be bypassed.
    • Offer consolidated bundle shipping (one shipping charge for the whole package) and a premium quick-view product modal.
    • Drop it on any page with the [musafid_package_builder] shortcode.

  2. Wishlist (Guest & Logged-in)

    • Let shoppers save products for later as a guest (cookie) or logged-in customer, with lists merged automatically on login.
    • Add/remove buttons on shop and product pages, a wishlist counter, and a “My Wishlist” account tab.
    • Shareable, read-only wishlist links via copy or WhatsApp. Shortcodes: [musafid_wishlist], [musafid_wishlist_count].

  3. Fraud Guard (Spam & Fake Order Prevention)

    • Block fake or spam orders using IP, email, and phone blacklists (CIDR and wildcard supported).
    • Checkout velocity limits, an invisible honeypot bot trap, and per-category/product purchase limits.
    • Hard-block or shadow-block handling, plus a privacy-masked blocked-activity log.

  4. Checkout Optimization & Custom Fields

    • Add, edit, or remove custom checkout fields — including validated Email, Number, and Phone fields — for billing, shipping, or order notes.
    • Display custom payment notes based on payment methods (instructions for local mobile money, etc.).
    • Increase average order value (AOV) with checkout Order Bumps and cross-sell offers.

  5. Sales, Dynamic Pricing & BOGO Deals

    • Create dynamic discount rules (percentage or fixed amount off) for specific categories or all products.
    • Set up high-converting “Buy One Get One” (BOGO) offers with stock validation.
    • Drive urgency with automated flash sale countdown timers and customize “Sale!” badges.

  6. Product Display & Conversion Boosters

    • Show stock-urgency messaging, image zoom, and a quick-view popup on the shop.
    • Let shoppers compare products side by side to make faster buying decisions.

  7. Custom Order Status, Notes & PDF Invoices

    • Create and organize custom order statuses with custom badge colors, and reassign orders safely on deletion.
    • Save time with pre-defined Order Note Templates and auto-populated placeholders (order total, customer name, date).
    • Generate clean, printable PDF invoices for customers.

  8. Analytics & Abandoned Cart Recovery

    • Monitor store performance via a secure, transient-cached Revenue Dashboard.
    • Track and recover abandoned guest/user carts with GDPR-compliant masked customer data.
    • Identify top-performing customers by Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).

  9. Email Branding & Review Requests

    • Custom-brand default WooCommerce emails (header color, footer text, additional notes).
    • Automate customer review request emails with secure, tokenized unsubscribe links.
    • Set up instant webhook alerts for order tracking.

Plus — Global Brand Colors: set a primary and secondary color once and apply your brand across every Musafid storefront module, with automatic contrast handling so buttons stay readable.

Privacy

Abandoned cart tracking (Analytics & Reporting)

This feature stores a snapshot of carts left without checkout. A snapshot may include the customer’s email address (if available), cart contents, and totals. It is used only to display potentially recoverable carts in your store admin.

  • Emails are masked when displayed in the admin.
  • Only the 100 most recent snapshots are retained.
  • A snapshot is removed automatically when its order is completed.
  • All stored data is deleted when the plugin is uninstalled, unless “Keep settings & data” is enabled.

Order alert webhook (Email & Notifications)

If you configure an order-alert webhook URL (e.g. Zapier, Twilio, or a WhatsApp Business endpoint), this plugin will POST order details — including the customer’s name, email, and phone — to that URL when a new order is placed. Data is sent only to the endpoint you configure; it is your responsibility to ensure that endpoint handles personal data appropriately. If no webhook URL is set, nothing is transmitted.

The plugin itself does not send data to any service operated by the plugin author.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the musafid folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to Musafid in your WordPress sidebar dashboard to enable modules and configure settings.
sections.faq:
Does Musafid slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Musafid is built with performance in mind. Using static memory caching and database transient storage, it reduces query counts. Since it is fully modular, only the code for the modules you explicitly activate is loaded on your storefront.

Can I customize WooCommerce checkout fields using Musafid?

Yes! The Checkout Optimization module allows you to create custom text, textarea, select, and checkbox fields. They are safely prefixed to prevent collisions with WooCommerce core keys.

How do I set up Buy One Get One Free (BOGO) deals?

Enable the Sales & Discounts module. Go to the BOGO tab, define the trigger product and the free/discounted product. The plugin handles stock checks automatically and caps excessive quantities to prevent checkout abuse.

Does it support WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes, Musafid is 100% compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and standard post-based database tables.

Are customer emails kept private (GDPR compliant)?

Absolutely. Our Analytics dashboard masks billing emails (e.g., cu***er@example.com) to ensure GDPR compliance while keeping your reports secure.

Can customers build their own product bundle?

Yes. Enable the Package Builder module, set your discount tiers (by item count or cart total, percentage or fixed), then add the [musafid_package_builder] shortcode to any page. Customers pick products, see a live discount preview, and add the whole package to the cart. All discounts are recalculated and enforced on the server, so they can’t be tampered with.

Does Musafid include a wishlist for WooCommerce?

Yes. The Wishlist module works for both guests (stored in a cookie) and logged-in customers (saved to their account and merged on login). It adds wishlist buttons, a counter, a “My Wishlist” account tab, and shareable read-only wishlist links via copy or WhatsApp.

Can I match the plugin to my store’s brand colors?

Yes. Under the Musafid settings you can set a primary and secondary brand color. These apply across all storefront modules automatically, and button text contrast is adjusted for readability.

Can I add validated email or phone fields to the checkout?

Yes. The Checkout Optimization module supports custom fields of type Text, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, Email, Number, and Phone. Email, number, and phone fields are automatically validated when the customer places an order, so you collect clean, usable data instead of typos.

Will Musafid stay fast on a store with thousands of orders?

Yes. The Analytics dashboard loads orders in a capped, performance-safe way (with a clear notice when a store is very large), and abandoned-cart records are cleaned up automatically on a schedule you control — so the dashboard stays responsive as your store grows.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Improvement: Analytics is now faster and safer on large stores — order loading is capped with a clear on-screen notice, and abandoned carts are automatically cleaned up on a schedule you control (default 30 days).
  • Improvement: Deleting a custom order status now lets you choose which status existing orders are moved to, processes them in safe batches, and never leaves orders stranded on a removed status.
  • Improvement: Checkout custom fields now support Email, Number, and Phone types with built-in validation, so you collect cleaner, usable order data.

1.2.0

  • New: Package Builder module — let customers build a custom product package and earn tiered discounts (by item count or cart total, percentage or fixed). Includes minimum/maximum item rules, consolidated bundle shipping, a quick-view product modal, and server-side discount enforcement. Add it to any page with [musafid_package_builder].
  • New: Global Brand Colors — set a primary and secondary color once and apply your brand across all Musafid storefront modules, with automatic contrast handling for readable buttons.
  • Improvement: refined storefront UI for the Package Builder (responsive two-column layout, clearer product selection, square product thumbnails).

1.1.0

  • New: Wishlist module — save products as a guest (cookie) or logged-in user (synced on login). Add/remove buttons on shop and product pages, wishlist count, “My Wishlist” account tab and [musafid_wishlist] shortcode, add-to-cart from the wishlist, and shareable read-only wishlist links (copy or WhatsApp).
  • New: Fraud Guard module — block fake/spam orders via IP, email and phone blacklists (with CIDR and wildcard support), checkout velocity limits, an invisible honeypot bot trap, per-category/product purchase limits, and a blocked-activity log. Choose hard-block or shadow-block handling.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Features 6 powerful modules: Order Management, Sales & Discounts, Product Display, Checkout Optimization, Analytics & Reporting, and Email Notifications.
  • Fully optimized for WPCS, security, and multisite environments.
